name: agent-house
description: Agent House: AI agents for small businesses, a tool catalogue for developers, and pay-per-call tools for agents (x402). One Cloudflare Worker.

scripts.setup: node scripts/dev-secrets.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply agent-house --local && node scripts/local-store.mjs
scripts.deploy: node scripts/predeploy-check.mjs && npm run web:build && wrangler deploy
scripts.test:workspace: cd apps/web && DEMO=1 node build.mjs && cd ../.. && node tests/e2e/workspace-qa.mjs
